written: 2026-10-02, before any system was built or any window run
question: Does a lambda ladder spaced for uniform work-distribution overlap, with replicates from separate equilibrations, reproduce the published met-enkephalin delta/mu selectivity? Only if it does may the same protocol be used to quote a value for YGGFEVVG.

what_changed_from_cycle_8.ladder: 27 windows -> 57. Spaced by equal thermodynamic length (equal sqrt(s) per interval) rather than by round numbers: 26 charge-decoupling intervals at a predicted s = 0.957 kT and 30 vdW intervals at 1.004 kT, against a measured maximum of 10.56 kT on the old ladder.
what_changed_from_cycle_8.duplicate_removed: old states 10 and 11 were both (coul=1.00, vdw=0.00) -- identical. One window was sampling a state indistinguishable from its neighbour.
what_changed_from_cycle_8.path_ordering: charges are fully removed before vdW softening begins; no interval changes both components. The corner (1.0, 0.0) is a hard node.
what_changed_from_cycle_8.replicates: generated by independent velocity assignment AND independent NVT+NPT equilibration. In Cycle 8 both replicates were grompp'd from the same equilibrated structure with continuation=yes and ld-seed=-1, so they differed only in thermostat seed and their spread measured thermal noise within one basin -- not structural uncertainty.
what_changed_from_cycle_8.unchanged: force field, soft-core (sc-alpha 0.5, sc-power 1, sc-sigma 0.3), sd integrator, 310 K, semiisotropic C-rescale, couple-intramol=yes, 3 ns per window, couple-moltype=system2 verified by molecular formula.

gates.G1_overlap: median relative entropy s < 1.5 kT and no more than 3 of 56 intervals above 2 kT, in every leg. This is a property of the ladder and must pass before any free energy is read.
gates.G2_sign: met-enkephalin ddG(DOR-MOR) > 0, i.e. delta-preferring, matching the published +0.81 kcal/mol.
gates.G3_accuracy: the 2-replicate mean ddG lies within 1.5 kcal/mol of the published +0.81.
gates.G4_reproducibility: the two separate-equilibration replicates agree within 2.0 kcal/mol. On the old ladder engPENK replicates differed by 5.03 and the MOR arm by 4.01.

decision_rule: If G1 fails, the re-spacing did not work and no free energy is reported from this ladder either. If G1 passes but G2 or G3 fails, the protocol is not capable of this measurement and the engPENK stage is NOT run -- 4.5 days of cluster time saved rather than spent producing a number that cannot be defended. Only if G1-G4 all pass does engPENK run on the identical ladder.
stated_prior: G1 should pass, because it is arithmetic: s scales as the square of the spacing and the ladder was built to a measured length. G2-G4 I genuinely do not know. The method has now failed a sign test twice, and poor overlap is a sufficient but not necessarily the only cause.
prohibited: No YGGFEVVG value may be quoted from this cycle unless G1-G4 all pass. A failure of the old ladder does not license the opposite conclusion about delta-preference; the poster's position (design goal, not demonstrated result) stands either way.
